name: rooted-fqn-migration
body:
The operational migration that re-points every authored `implemented-by` edge target to its rooted FQN after the FQN change. Because the code universe shifts (every code FQN gains its language root), the existing targets become DRIFT; the migration replaces each unrooted target with its rooted equivalent through the node/edge mutation surface (`apg edge rm implemented-by …` + `apg edge add implemented-by …`), each replacement atomic across both endpoint files.

It is a data/layer migration, not net-new behaviour: it uses the existing edge surface, and the branch re-scan is what makes the rooted code FQNs real and surfaces any remaining drift. The sequence is: FQN change lands → branch re-scan → re-point the edges → validation/re-scan confirms no drift.
